MERGE INTO T_CASSETTE_STATUS t USING (SELECT #{termGroupId,jdbcType=CHAR} AS TG, #{termId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TI, #{cassetteType,jdbcType=CHAR} AS CT,
CAST(#{cassetteNo,jdbcType=CHAR} AS CHAR(5)) AS CN FROM dual) s ON (t.TERM_GROUP_ID = s.TG AND t.TERM_ID = s.TI AND t.CASSETTE_TYPE = s.CT AND t.CASSETTE_NO = s.CN) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.DENOM_CD = #{denomCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.CURRENCY_CD = #{currencyCd,jdbcType=CHAR}, t.REMAIN_COUNT = #{remainCount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.STATUS = #{status,jdbcType=CHAR}, t.CHECK_NO = #{checkNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, CASSETTE_TYPE, CASSETTE_NO, DENOM_CD, CURRENCY_CD, REMAIN_COUNT, STATUS, CHECK_NO ) VALUES ( #{termGroupId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{termId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cassetteType,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{cassetteNo,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{denomCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{currencyCd,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{remainCount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{status,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{checkNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
